items.evidence: Reservoir in slot 1 and plate in slot 2 are loaded with the required labels. The p20 (left) and p300 (right) are loaded with tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
The log shows 12 pairs of aspirate 100 uL from reservoir A1 and dispense 100 uL into plate A1 through A12, all with the P300. No other wells are touched.
One tip is picked up in log step 1 before any aspiration. It is reused for all wells and dropped in the final log step.
apiLevel 2.15 is within the allowed range. 100 uL is within the P300 limits, and the run log shows no unsafe actions.
The protocol performs only the requested 100 uL transfer to A1-A12. Its comments are accurate, and the blow_out over each well does not change the outcome.

judge.summary: The protocol loads the specified labware and instruments, and transfers 100 uL from reservoir A1 to each of plate wells A1-A12 with the P300. It uses one tip that is picked up before the first aspiration and dropped at the end, so every rubric item passes.
